benchmarks.title: CDC Lyme disease reported cases by year, 2022-2023 (national totals)
benchmarks.why: Lyme disease: national reported cases and health-center visits
benchmarks.summary: 2022-2023: annual reported cases (confirmed plus probable) range 62,549 to 89,469; confirmed alone 2,192 to 3,531.
benchmarks.how_to_use: Cross-check the document's national case count or incidence for the same year, and state whether the two are on the same definition.

provenance.collection_note: Case reports submitted by state health departments; passive reporting, so counts are a subset of true cases.
provenance.computed_by: Computed in code from the federal file; no AI model
provenance.relevance: A reported surveillance case is not the same denominator as a diagnosed-and-treated insurance episode; claims-based studies commonly estimate several times more.
provenance.reliability: Counts, not estimates; subject to under-reporting and to the 2022 definition change.

limits: A reported surveillance case is not the same denominator as a diagnosed-and-treated insurance episode; claims-based studies commonly estimate several times more.
Do not combine eras: the surveillance definition changed in 2022 (most cases are then classed "Probable"), so compare confirmed-plus-probable totals, not confirmed alone.

benchmarks.title: NAMCS Health Center visits with Lyme disease (ICD-10-CM A69.2x) listed, 2024
benchmarks.why: Lyme disease: national reported cases and health-center visits
benchmarks.summary: 2024: about 30,687 weighted health-center visits listed Lyme disease (ICD-10-CM A69.2x) (157 sampled visits; meets the 30-record reliability floor).
benchmarks.how_to_use: Context or cross-check for a document that reports health-center or outpatient visit counts; never a national prevalence or a cost.

provenance.collection_note: Diagnoses recorded for a national sample of visits to community health centers; visits, not people.
provenance.computed_by: Computed in code from the federal file; no AI model
provenance.relevance: Community health centers only: not all outpatient care in the United States.
provenance.reliability: 157 sampled visits; meets the 30-record reliability floor.

limits: Community health centers only: not all outpatient care in the United States.
Counts visits, not people, and not dollars; one person can appear in several visits.

benchmarks.title: BLS CPI-U (all items) annual averages, for inflation adjustment
benchmarks.why: Restates any dollar figure in current dollars
benchmarks.how_to_use: Restate a dollar figure in another price year: value x CPI(target year) / CPI(source year), and label the result as inflation-adjusted, not measured.

provenance.collection_note: CPI-U all-items index measured and published by BLS; a restatement multiplies by its ratio.
provenance.computed_by: Computed in code from the federal file; no AI model
provenance.relevance: General price inflation, not medical-care inflation; say so when adjusting medical costs.
provenance.reliability: Published index; general prices, not medical-care prices.

limits: General price inflation, not medical-care inflation; say so when adjusting medical costs.
